title: Search Algorithm Trainer graph
description: A search problem for the Search Algorithm Trainer. Import it in the app via Graph editor → Import JSON. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (checked by the app on import/save): every edge's "from"/"to" and the "start"/"goal" must be ids of existing nodes; node ids must be unique; no self-loops. Greedy and A* are only offered if EVERY node has an "h" value.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor autocompletion. Ignored by the app.

id.description: Optional. The app assigns a fresh id on import, so this is only informative.

description.description: One or two sentences shown under the name.

note.description: Optional teaching note shown in the side panel while playing (e.g. explain a trap in this graph).

directed.description: true: edges can only be followed from → to. false: every edge works in both directions.

weighted.description: false: every edge costs 1 and edge weights are ignored.

difficulty.description: Tag shown on the graph card. Custom graphs can be played in every difficulty mode.

dlsLimit.description: Default depth limit ℓ for depth-limited search.

nodeId.description: Letters, digits, space, _ or -; max 20 characters. Ids of 1-2 characters are drawn inside the circle, longer ids as a label below it. Alphabetical order of ids decides tie-breaking and successor order.

x.description: Horizontal position on the 800 × 500 canvas. Keep 30-770 so the node is fully visible.

y.description: Vertical position on the 800 × 500 canvas (0 = top). Keep 30-470 so the node is fully visible.

h.description: Heuristic estimate of the cost from this node to the goal. Required on every node for Greedy and A*. h(goal) should be 0. Admissible = never larger than the true cost; consistent = h(n) ≤ cost(n, n') + h(n') for every edge.

w.description: Step cost (must be > 0). Ignored when the graph is unweighted. If the same pair is connected twice, the cheaper edge is used.
